Understanding Overstay Fines in Abu Dhabi, UAE

Abu Dhabi is a place where most people get lost in the beautiful scenery. They are so lost that they even forget about their days to stay in Abu Dhabi. This is called overstaying, but wait a minute, you don’t need to overthink it. It happens to most of the individuals. You can just pay your fines and stay as long as you want

UAE Overstay: What Does it Mean?

Overstay occurs when a visitor or resident remains in the UAE after their visa or residency permit has expired without renewal or exit. According to ICP UAE, overstaying results in daily fines and may lead to legal consequences if not resolved.

Consequences of Overstaying in Abu Dhabi, UAE

As a UAE resident or expat, you must know the consequences of overstaying in the UAE. It is necessary to know so that you can avoid this situation.

Overstaying is not just about paying fines. It may lead to:

  • Accumulated daily penalties
  • Travel restrictions or immigration blocks
  • Difficulty in visa renewal or new applications
  • Possible deportation in severe cases
  • Entry bans for repeated violations

Additionally, individuals who overstay may face legal proceedings. Sometimes they are deported from the country. Also, they are subject to bans from entering the UAE again. You can exit the UAE, but you must first clear all fines and may need an exit permit.

Where to Check Overstay Fines in Abu Dhabi, UAE?

You can check the overstay fine online through two websites. These are the GDFRA and ICP websites. Also, you can inquire by contacting the ICP toll-free number

Verification channels for overstay fines

There are two verification channels where you can check your overstay fines. For checking overstay fines, you can visit the GDFRA and ICP websites. On opening the websites, navigate to the UAE Visa Services. Now, visit the Check Fines option. Here, you can get information about your overstay fine

Required Information for Overstay Fine Checking

To check your overstay fine in the UAE, visit the ICP website. Also, you can inquire by contacting their toll-free number 600522222. Here you can learn about everything regarding visas. It includes visa issuance, visa types, and validity

Step-by-Step Guide to Checking Overstay Fines Online

There are a few steps involved in checking your overstay fines online. These include:

  1. At first, you need to open the ‘ICP Smart Service Website.’
  2. Here, click on ‘Fines and Leave Permits’ Options
  3. Select search method:
    • Passport number
    • Emirates ID
    • Visa file number
  4. Enter required details
  5. View your fine instantly

Check Your UAE Overstay Fine on the GDRFA Website (Dubai Only)

You can check your overstay fine on the GDRFA website through the following steps:

  1. Visit the GDFRA website
  2. Click on ‘Fines and Inquiry Services’
  3. Select File Number
  4. Enter:
    • Emirates ID or file number
  5. Click search

Check via Mobile Apps

You can also check fines through:

  • ICP UAE mobile app
  • UAE PASS integrated services

Offline Methods

You can check fines physically at:

  • Immigration offices in Abu Dhabi
  • Typing centers
  • Airport immigration counters

Is there a Grace Period for Overstaying in the UAE?

As a UAE resident, you can overstay. But you are required to apply for a grace period of up to 30 days. This grace period is available only in certain circumstances. These include:

Grace periods depend on visa type:

  • Residence Visa: 30 to 180 days (depending on visa category)
  • Visit/Tourist Visa: Usually, no grace period or very limited duration

Note: Grace periods are automatically granted, not applied for.

Latest Overstay Fine in UAE (2026)

As per updated UAE immigration rules:

  • Overstay fine: AED 50 per day
  • Applies to:
    • Visit visa
    • Tourist visa
    • Residence visa

Additional charges may include:

  • Exit permit fees
  • Status change fees (if applicable)

Tips to Avoid Overstay Fines

  • Track your visa expiry date
  • Apply for renewal early
  • Use reminders or alerts
  • Apply for a visa extension if needed
  • Check the status regularly online

Conclusion

In conclusion, you need to know your visa status frequently. However, if you by chance forget it. Then you don’t need to worry about it. You can overstay your visit there, but you will be fined. You can check the UAE overstay fine on the GDFRA and ICP websites. Typically, it costs you around 50 AED per day. It applies to everyone, whether you are on a visit visa, tourist visa, or residence visa. Still, to avoid any serious consequences, it is essential to check it online

FAQs:

What is the overstay fine in Abu Dhabi in 2026?

The overstay fine is AED 50 per day for all visa types, as per UAE immigration rules.

How can I check my UAE overstay fine online?

You can check your fine through the ICP website using your passport number, Emirates ID, or visa file number.

Can I leave the UAE without paying overstay fines?

No, you must pay all fines and may need a leave permit before exiting.

Is there a grace period after visa expiry?

Yes, for residence visas (30–180 days depending on category). Visit visas usually have no grace period.

How do I pay my overstay fine in Abu Dhabi?

You can pay online via ICP or offline at immigration offices, airports, or typing centers.
